3. **Ninh Binh**: The Investor article from February 2025 indicates both Pha Lai (440 MW) and Ninh Binh (100 MW) face potential closure by 2030 unless they upgrade technology and emissions standards, with the World Bank exploring repurposing options. Ninh Binh remains operational currently.

Long Phu 1 has been stalled at 78% completion since March 2019 due to US sanctions affecting Power Machines, though PVN is now working to restart it with an updated feasibility study targeting 2027 completion. Vung Ang 2's Unit 1 reached commercial operation in July 2025 with 1,330 MW of USC capacity. The revised PDP8 framework caps total coal capacity at roughly 31 GW by 2030, with five plants still under construction: Vung Ang II, Na Duong II, Quang Trach I, An Khanh-Bac Giang, and Long Phu 1.
